::: {#exm-sample-vs-population-mean}
#### Sample mean versus population mean of cholesterol

The [population mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of cholesterol
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation)
of the population distribution (@def-population-distribution).
It is a fixed number that we do not know.
The sample mean (@def-sample-mean) of the `wcgs` data,
`r round(mean(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` mg/dL,
is computed from the observed data.
A different sample from the same population would give a different sample mean,
while the population mean would not change.
:::
